goal.summary: 主线全部关卡·普通难度、从新存档按顺序整局通关的智能体（8B 策略脑 + 小网络操作脑）

native-survey.purpose: historic determinism re-verification; all-level scripted survey with build/send_wave only; first-wave probe

native-diagnose.purpose: locate the first divergence of non-reproducible survey plans; test sound-RNG isolation

native-verify.purpose: verify full-episode cold-replay determinism under isolate_sound+stable_pairs

native-teacher.purpose: native verification of action scope v2 receipts and a first all-level teacher_v2 survey

native-search.purpose: parallel build-order search (steady-state GA) per main-campaign level on a train seed, campaign-consistent star upgrades (2 stars per earlier level) and free heroes, then validation of the best plans on the other train seeds; run 2: headless engine (no joystick subsystem) after input-device enumeration stalled new processes in run 1; run 3: worker processes (run 2 was bound to one core), warm start from runs 1-2, OpenAL null output; run 4: levels 1-8 and 10-12, fitness = mean over train seeds 1001 and 1002, warm-start plans re-played (not adopted), relocate/burst operators, validation on the other 8 train seeds; run 5: all levels with the sunray beam/aim actions (level 9) and the optional fallback tower ratio in plans; mean fitness over train seeds 1001-1002; validation on 1003-1010; run 6: validation of the solved levels 1-8 and 10 (best plans by mean fitness over seeds 1001-1002 adopted from runs 1-5, at most one new plan per level) on train seeds 1003-1010; run 7: the hard levels 9, 11 and 12 with finer loss fitness (lives into the last wave, damage to the strongest enemy), population 32, up to 1200 plans each, then validation; run 7b after a non-finite health value crashed run 7's journal write (fixed); run 7c: the boss is judged by the lowest health it was seen at during the whole episode; run 7d: v2 builds now take the GUI path, so discounted towers are no longer refused; run 8: optional boss-focus spell rule in plans, population 40 seeded by only the 8 best earlier plans per level (re-played) and filled with random plans for diversity; run 9: single-seed search (train seed 1001) on levels 9, 11 and 12 to find any winning plans, then validation of the 5 best per level on the other 9 train seeds (a portfolio for retries); run 10: the toughest enemy is judged by its last seen health (Vez'nan heals into a second phase); run 11: profiles at 2.75 stars per earlier level, the rate the agent earned in its rehearsals; run 12: episode cap raised to 240000 ticks / 3000 decisions (level 12's final walk exceeded 120000); run 13: star allocation packages (the upgrades screen's reset refunds every star, so a plan may name the allocation it is played with); the level 9, 11 and 12 populations of run 12 are adopted as measured and each adopted plan is also played with Rain of Fire upgraded first, then validation; run 14: new v2 action click_entity, the GUI click a game script waits for (J.T. knocked down waits for the finishing tap, so 3 earlier level-9 games ended at the tick cap with the boss at 4-24 HP and the level never closing; J.T.'s ice keeps a tower frozen until it is clicked 3 times); the 40 best plans per level of runs 12-13 are re-played with clicks, the search continues, then the 8 best per level are validated on the other train seeds; run 15: robust search for levels 11 and 12 (single-seed winners won only 0-4 of 9 other train seeds; level 12's wave composition varies by seed): fitness is the mean over train seeds 1001-1003, warm start from the 24 best plans per level of runs 12-14 re-played on all three, then validation of the 8 best on train seeds 1004-1010; run 16: level 12 only (its losses are final-wave damage races, Vez'nan escaping with 93-800 of 6666 HP): mean fitness over train seeds 1001-1003, run 15's population adopted as measured, 300 more plans, then the 8 best by fitness (not only plans that won every search seed) validated on train seeds 1004-1010; run 17: validation pass for level 11: run 15's population adopted as measured, one new plan, then the 12 best by mean fitness over seeds 1001-1003 validated on train seeds 1004-1010 for the retry portfolio; run 18: level 11 robust search (its best plan won 8 of 10 train seeds with only 3-9 lives left and lost at the decisive waves 9 and 13 elsewhere, a fragile plan): mean fitness over train seeds 1001-1005, the 24 best plans of runs 15 and 17 re-played on all five, 250 more plans, then the 10 best validated on train seeds 1006-1010; run 19: level 12 robust search after the evaluation-seed rehearsal cleared 5 of 10 campaigns and lost 4 at level 12 (final-wave escapes, or early waves on one seed): mean fitness over train seeds 1001-1005, the 24 best plans of runs 14-16 re-played on all five, 200 more plans, then the 10 best validated on train seeds 1006-1010
